No physical effects rerun

Uses existing Runner.Command.control/RunDecision.advance and flush
Does not mutate Clock service secretly
Does not apply pending replies by arrival order
Current emitted duration unit remains milliseconds
Plan success is not execution success; result phase must be read

Explicitly unavailable today
Existing target/snapshot insufficient
